title: Prevent post-archive PR coverage failures and recover within the same Work Item
rawUserRequest: Execute existing Issue #668 from clean current origin/main. Require changed-critical coverage before archive, and add a governed same-Work-Item recovery path for a post-archive PR-audit coverage or evidence failure that preserves immutable archive/Outcome history and avoids a duplicate successor. Incorporate #711 evidence but do not modify its archive or use manual rewrite. The user authorizes automatic execution and requires that authority to be recorded in every Work Item Contract.

declaredIntent.summary: Make changed-critical coverage an archive precondition and retain one immutable Work Item identity when a post-archive PR audit needs a narrowly governed repair.

outOfScope: Mutating the old blocked #668 Work Item, #711 archive, or any other immutable archive/Outcome evidence.
Publishing a release, merging a PR, changing GitHub provider state, or deleting branches outside this Work Item lifecycle.
Weakening coverage thresholds, bypassing PR audit, or treating a receipt as merge/release/closure authority.

sources.reason: User-authorized corrective Issue and its #711 acceptance case.
Canonical Finish/archive ordering and Outcome generation.
Canonical clean-commit aggregate PR audit and archive ownership boundary.
Existing base-bound coverage checker to make pre-archive and receipt-bound.
Current lifecycle instruction that incorrectly forces a fresh Work Item after archive.
Existing immutable archive and append-only recovery-receipt rules.

riskAssessment.reason: The change alters the archive/PR boundary. A malformed recovery route could rewrite evidence, hide failed coverage, or create an unowned PR diff.

reasons: Archive integrity and PR gating require strict verification.

executionDecision.reason: The Issue, authority, old-work-item quarantine receipt, scope, acceptance, and verification plan are explicit.

preReviewWarnings: The recovery receipt must be append-only and must never alter archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, or manifest bytes.
A pre-archive coverage pass must bind the Contract base and candidate state; it complements rather than replaces the clean committed PR audit.
The installed Makefile and runtime catalog must expose the same fail-closed command as the template source.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Archive-bound changes require a verified implementation boundary before edits and finish.

acceptance: Every archive path runs changed-critical coverage before archive mutation using the immutable Contract base; a missing or failing result produces a valid active blocked Outcome and leaves active evidence unarchived.
The changed-critical coverage report binds both Contract base and candidate Git/worktree identity, so stale or foreign results cannot authorize archive.

A post-archive PR-audit coverage or evidence failure can open an append-only, digest-bound same-Work-Item recovery receipt; it preserves archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, and manifest bytes while owning only declared recovery paths.
The PR audit rejects forged, stale, incomplete, out-of-scope, or unauthorized recovery receipts and retains the one-Work-Item ownership boundary.
The installed template distributes every required target/runtime dependency and documents the same recovery boundary.
Focused red/green regressions, installed-adopter parity, full quality, strict Finish, clean committed PR audit, hosted checks, merge, and governed closure pass.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Archive is requested without a passing base-bound candidate critical-coverage result.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Finish writes a red active Outcome, does not archive, and identifies the failed coverage gate.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add an ai_finish integration test that forces changed-critical coverage failure and asserts archive is not invoked.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A changed critical runtime file has coverage below its required floor before archive.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The pre-archive gate rejects the candidate before immutable archive mutation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use a realistic focused coverage fixture and assert the archive command never runs.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Post-archive check-ai-pr finds coverage or archive-bound evidence failure after a green Finish.
scenarioCoverage.expected: A same-Work-Item append-only receipt preserves the archived bytes, scopes repair paths, and permits a repaired PR audit without successor identity.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add receipt validation and aggregate PR ownership mutation tests with byte comparisons of archived evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An installed strict adopter invokes the same archive boundary.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Its Makefile and copied runtime provide the pre-archive gate and fail closed rather than omitting it.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Extend installer and Makefile parity tests.

guidelines: Preserve immutable archive evidence byte-for-byte; record recovery only in append-only, digest-bound artifacts.
Use executable negative and positive tests for each archive/PR ordering rule; do not rely on documentation alone.
Keep source-template and installed-adopter command surfaces in parity.
Do not treat a recovery receipt as authorization to merge, publish, delete branches, or close a Work Item.

intent.problem: #711 demonstrated that a green Finish/archive can still fail the later clean-commit critical coverage gate. The former process then required a duplicate successor for a small repair, while rewriting archive evidence is prohibited.
constraints: Run the critical coverage guard before archive.
Bind evidence to Contract base and candidate identity.
Use one same-Work-Item recovery receipt only for post-archive PR-audit coverage/evidence repair.
Do not weaken gates or create a new GitHub Issue.
intent.rationale: A pre-archive guard prevents most irreversible lifecycle inconsistencies; a narrow append-only receipt handles the remaining post-archive discovery without false Work Item proliferation.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User gave standing authorization to execute the plan automatically and record it in each Contract, including successor/quarantine and in-scope governance repairs.

rollbackNote: Revert only this Work Item diff. Do not alter old #668, #711, or any archived evidence while rolling back.
